workout.warmup: Incline walk · 8–10 min. THEN ramp-up sets on Leg Press before your heavy work (e.g. a light set of 8 and a medium set of 5) — heavy days need real warmup sets, not just the treadmill.
workout.finisher: Optional — skip the finisher walk on heavy days if the session runs long with the added rest.
workout.coach_note: START of your 2–3 week heavy strength block. You've been on 10s for ~2 months, so the main lifts now go HEAVY for 4x5–6 with longer rest (2–3 min) to build strength; accessories & core stay 10–15 for volume. Weights below are targets from your recent 10-rep loads — add weight until 5–6 is genuinely hard but clean. STRAPS on the RDL so your legs, not your grip, set the limit. PF machines vary by location (you're in Ballard this week) — gauge by feel.

exercises.name: Leg Press [HEAVY]
exercises.note: MAIN LIFT. You did 390 for 3x10 — for 5–6 reps go meaningfully heavier, work up to a load where set of 5–6 is hard but clean (likely ~440–480 + sled, but let feel decide). Do 2 ramp-up sets first. Controlled, no lockout, full depth you can control.

exercises.name: DB Romanian Deadlift [HEAVY — USE STRAPS]
exercises.note: MAIN LIFT. This is the day to use straps — grip capped you at 70 on 7/10 while your legs had more. Strap in and go to ~75–85 for hard sets of 6. Hinge from the hips, soft knees, flat back, feel the hamstrings stretch. Straps = legs set the limit, not your hands.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.note: Accessory — stays in the higher rep range for hamstring volume. 70 for 10–12, chase 12. Weak-link muscle, keep the reps up.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.note: Accessory quad volume. Squeeze at the top, slow negative. Burn out the quads after the heavy pressing.

exercises.name: Core Circuit — 2 rounds
exercises.detail: Hanging Knee Raise x12 → Pallof Press 40 x10/side → Side Plank 30s/side
exercises.note: Back-safe, fresh combo. Pallof on cable at 40 (band if taken).
